sources.title: BAE beats out 6 to win $129M FBI Terrorist Screening Center Analysis Services contract

data.target: FBI TSC historical-to-current contractor and personnel cross-match
data.research_question: Which historical TSC contractors or personnel reappear among the seven 2025 offerors, the current BAE team, or FBI-TSC-AIE respondents?
hypotheses: The 2025 offer-receipt and unsuccessful-offeror records identify continuity from earlier TSC contractor teams.
BAE subcontract records identify whether the 2020 Cyberspace Solutions relationship continued.
Archived FBI forecasts and industry-day lists expose additional company and personnel leads.
objectives: Run and preserve the official FBI procurement collection.
Recover the 2025 solicitation, offer-receipt log and unsuccessful-offeror notices.
Recover BAE key-personnel and subcontract records.
Recover FBI-TSC-AIE response and briefing metadata.
